# Aura Sites

> Aura Sites is a web design studio based in Tokyo that builds custom,
> handcrafted websites for restaurants and small businesses, with a focus
> on bilingual (English/Japanese) sites that help owners reach foreign
> tourists and customers. Every site is set up to be easy for search
> engines and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) to find,
> understand and recommend. Pages are available in English and Japanese
> through a language switch on each page (not separate URLs).

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://aurasites.studio/): overview, process, portfolio, pricing (Launch, Grow, Studio tiers), FAQ.
- [English websites for restaurants in Tokyo](https://aurasites.studio/restaurant-websites-tokyo.html): who this service is for, what's included, and real prices.
- [About](https://aurasites.studio/about.html): founder, languages spoken, why Aura Sites exists.
- [Asiatis case study](https://aurasites.studio/case-study-asiatis.html): a real bilingual website Aura Sites built, for a certified translation agency.
- [Privacy policy](https://aurasites.studio/privacy.html).
